verdict.rationale: Raygun documents API endpoints secured by an external access token, including a Deployments API and API-based uploads of source maps, dSYMs and ProGuard files (raygun-docs-8, raygun-docs-15). Nothing in the pack shows a general public API for driving core product actions such as querying error groups, changing statuses or managing applications, and the OpenAPI probes returned 404 (raygun-probe-2). missing for 10: a documented general-purpose REST API covering core crash-reporting and APM operations, a published API reference/OpenAPI spec, independent corroboration of programmatic use.
